pacnw-2020.notes: Twelve of the seventeen QOJ statement PDFs (sources 10, 13, 15-23, 25) carry the footer 'ICPC Southeast USA 2020 Regional Contest' with Southeast letters, not a Pacific Northwest footer; their text matches the Pacific Northwest Division 2 set (source 8) word for word where that set has the problem, while TripTik, Condorcet, Kth Subtree and Exciting Tournament (17, 19, 20, 22) are not in the Division 2 set and could not be compared. Only 9, 11, 12, 14 and 24 carry 'Pacific Northwest 2020—Division 1' footers. Someone may want to decide whether the Southeast-labelled PDFs should be filed under the Southeast USA 2020 contest as well or instead.

pacnw-2021.notes: Ten of the thirteen QOJ statement PDFs (sources 10, 11, 12, 15, 16, 18, 19, 20, 21, 22) are the 2021 ICPC Southeast USA Regional's versions (header 'The 2021 ICPC Southeast USA Regional Contest', SER letters and time limits, e.g. Circle Bounce as B with 1 s, Shortest Missing Subsequences as G with 8 s vs 10 s in the PacNW set); same titles as PacNW problems but SER documents, so wrong-contest. Source 15 is SER Division 2 problem G Rise and Fall. Only sources 13, 14 and 17 print the Pacific Northwest footer. Sources 8 and 9 (Div 1 A-M, Div 2 N-Z, both dated 5 March 2022) agree with the catalogue's problem list.
